reviews.title: Great AIO. Definitely give it a try.
reviews.comment:
Swapped from my lian li galahad 360mm AIO and temps dropped over 10C. This AIO works great and looks amazing AND its cheaper than most any AIO with a screen on the market. The software isn't as streamlined as others, but the options are all there. You just have to mess with the settings a little bit. While software isn't as streamlined, it also hasn't caused issues like the L-connect software has caused for me. I've had the L-connect software conflict with several other programs and cause issues.
I definitely recommend giving this AIO a try if you're on the fence and looking at it.
reviews.author: matt

reviews.title: Fantastic value
reviews.comment:
Great performance with an attractive design and the bonus screen. The included fans look nice when viewed from the front but are a bit too simple when viewed from the side. Installation is very simple on the AM5 platform but the hose was a bit stiff from my use case as the tubes exit from the right side. Having every fan pre-installed is a great idea but there's a bit of cables due to the pump + fans requiring both the fan and ARGB cables. The included fan controller is a nice bonus for management though.
The performance has been amazing; my AMD Ryzen 9 7950X does not throttle even if the temperatures creep towards 95c (tjmax). I switched over from a bigger case with a 420 AIO cooler so I'm satisfied. The fans can get loud at higher speeds but can easily be software controlled or limited with a switch on their back (requires removing from the radiator). I haven't had any issues with the software but simple enough to use and adjust the image on the screen.
reviews.author: Eric

reviews.title: Price and Style! Oh, did I mention Price?
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/F14MarA6y7L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71pySw5D2qL._SY256.jpg This product does more than just keep your CPU cool — it really enhances the look of your setup. It’s impressive how it combines premium quality with an affordable price. The detachable LCD with built-in magnets is a great touch, letting you place it anywhere on your case without taking up extra space. I also love that you can upload your own content instead of being limited to what comes with the software. Overall, it’s a stylish, functional, and budget-friendly upgrade. I’m very happy with this purchase and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to add both flair and performance to their build.
